The site looked different because the font wasn't loading. `site/css/tokens.css` pointed at `../font/acme-sans.woff2`, but the file lives in `site/fonts/`. The request returned a 404, so every page fell back to a default font.

I changed the path to `../fonts/acme-sans.woff2`. After that, all 12 visual comparisons (6 pages at desktop and phone size) match the approved baselines. I didn't run the functional tests, and I didn't approve any baselines.

The repo has only the initial commit, so I couldn't check which change introduced the wrong path.
